accepted.quote: Apply 4 to 7 days prior to defoliant.

accepted.quote: For best performance, by ground or air application, choose equipment and spray volumes that will insure uniform coverage of foliage and bolls.

accepted.quote: Do not exceed a maximum of 2. 0 lb. ethephon active ingredient per acre per year through combined or repeated uses of any ethephon products.

accepted.quote: DO NOT APPLY PREP™ BRAND ETHEPHON FOR COTTON AND TOBACCO IF RAIN IS EXPECTED WITHIN 6 HOURS.

accepted.summary: rainfall within 6 hours may reduce product performance
accepted.quote: Rainfall within 6 hours of application may reduce product performance.

accepted.summary: plant-back interval
accepted.quote: Do not plant another crop within 30 days after treatment.

accepted.summary: small grains may only be used as cover crops and not harvested for food or feed
accepted.quote: Small grains planted earlier than 1 month or intercropped with the cotton crop to which PREP™ brand Ethephon for Cotton and Tobacco will be applied may only be used as cover crops and may not be harvested for food or feed.

accepted.summary: ethephon may cause yellowing and growth inhibition of treated small grains
accepted.quote: PREP™ brand Ethephon for Cotton and Tobacco may cause yellowing and growth inhibition of treated small grains.

accepted.summary: pre-harvest interval
accepted.quote: Do not harvest cotton sooner than 7 days after a treatment with PREP™ brand Ethephon for Cotton and Tobacco.

accepted.summary: harvest when optimum boll opening reached
accepted.quote: Observe the treated crop and harvest when optimum boll opening has been reached.

accepted.summary: too early harvest might reduce full advantage; too late may reduce quality and lint loss
accepted.quote: Too early harvest might reduce the full advantage of the treatment and too late a harvest may result in reduced quality and loss of lint which will drop from the plant.

accepted.summary: use drop nozzles with TG or OC spray tips
accepted.quote: Use drop nozzles. Choose TG or OC spray tips designed to apply 50 - 60 gpa at 35 -40 psi and at tractor speed of 2- 3 mph.

accepted.summary: use 2 nozzles per row, one on each side, dropped low to direct spray to leaves
accepted.quote: Use 2 nozzles per row; one on each side of the row dropped low enough to direct the spray to the leaves to be ripened and harvested.

accepted.summary: thorough spray coverage is essential
accepted.quote: Thorough spray coverage is essential.

accepted.summary: harvest all leaves with 20% or more yellowing
accepted.quote: With a directed spray, be sure to harvest all leaves with 20% or more yellowing.

accepted.summary: treat only when leaves remaining on stalk are mature
accepted.quote: Treat only when leaves remaining on the stalk are mature.

accepted.summary: test spray several tobacco plants to ensure maturity
accepted.quote: To ensure remaining leaves are mature, test spray several tobacco plants as described under the section "Proper Time of Treatment."

accepted.summary: use lower rate in normally mature crop when minimum ripening inducement required
accepted.quote: Use the lower rate in a normally mature crop when experience indicates that minimum ripening inducement is required.

accepted.summary: use higher rate when crop is heavy and rank or temperatures lower than normal
accepted.quote: Use the higher rate when the crop is heavy and has a tendency to be more rank or when temperatures are lower than normal.

accepted.summary: always test spray to determine if tobacco is mature enough to respond to treatment
accepted.quote: Always test spray to determine if the tobacco is mature enough to respond to treatment with PREP™ brand Ethephon for Cotton and Tobacco.

accepted.quote: Apply over-the-top PREP™ brand Ethephon for Cotton and Tobacco spray as a fine mist using three nozzles (one nozzle tip over the center of the plant, and one on each side) so all leaves are covered thoroughly, similar to the application pattern of systemic sucker control agents.

accepted.summary: use spray pressure of 40 to 60 psi
accepted.quote: Use a spray pressure of 40 to 60 psi.

accepted.summary: do not apply to immature leaves
accepted.quote: Do not apply PREP™ brand Ethephon for Cotton and Tobacco to immature leaves as this can result in unsatisfactory coloring, weight loss and reduced leaf quality.

accepted.quote: Do not allow the crop to over ripen in the field after using PREP™ brand Ethephon for Cotton and Tobacco, since this may cause some reduction in yield and quality.
